9.2 Personal data, relevant searches and intelligible copies

Sections 4.3 and 4.6. Michael Ashley v Commissioners for HMRC [2025] EWHC 134 (KB) supports examining

information about an individual by its content, purpose or effect, considering relevant departmental holdings,

and supplying context where necessary for intelligibility.

The tax-investigation facts differ from this review.

The judgment rejects treating an entire enquiry, every policy document or all decision-making reasoning as

personal data.

Its application to held DWP records requires the relevant information and controller relationship, not an

assumption about what exists.

The current search limit is UK GDPR Article 15(1A), inserted by DUAA section 78: reasonable and proportionate

searches.

Section 78 came into force on Royal Assent, 19 June 2025, under section 142(2)(b); it did not require inclusion in

SI 2026/82.

Please identify the relevant holdings searched and explain limitations insofar as legally permissible.

Access remains to personal data and required supplementary information, with necessary context; it is not

unrestricted document disclosure.

Article 15(4) and DPA 2018 Schedule 2, including applicable crime/risk-assessment, third-party and privilege

provisions, may limit disclosure where their specific conditions are satisfied.

A general “review” label does not itself establish an exemption. [6]



9.3 Lawful processing, privacy and automation

Section 4.4. UK GDPR Article 15(1)(a)-(d), (g)-(h) concerns purposes, categories, recipients, retention, sources

and applicable automation information.

Articles 13(1)(c) and 14(1)(c) separately address purposes and legal basis when their conditions apply.

Article 6 and DWP’s charter permit grounds other than consent, including legal obligations and public functions.

Please identify the actual ground and purpose here and how relevant, proportionate evidence and incidental

third-party data are handled.

External recipients and internal staff acting under the controller’s authority are different questions; usable

role/team contact is requested without asserting a right to all staff names. [5][6]
